status: fitted simple benchmark; not prospectively validated
architecture: 18 additive coefficients:9 provenance offsets,4 monotone shade increments,4 monotone vintage increments,1 nonnegative lighter-tare slope. No regional hierarchy overlays, context curves, fusion, or hard zero-price constraints.
target_cautions: Meaningfulness primary, known direction secondary. Historical ties are coarsened only to absence of expressed meaningful preference, never forced zero. Moderate/strong qualifiers are flagged positive proxies pending fresh direct validation. Unspecified meaningfulness remains missing, not silently converted. Exact-price semantics remain in original evidence/audit.

loss_conventions.note: Model-scale conventions, not user-supplied percentages or prices. One observation can constrain direction and practical closeness without becoming two samples.
